title: Lecture 3 — lines, planes, and orthogonal projection
summary: Sections 1.3 and 7.7: parametric lines, plane equations, and projection onto a vector.
body:
Study lines and planes in space, then orthogonal projection onto a vector (Sections 1.3 and 7.7). This guide follows the published topic outline; it is not a class transcript.

Read the [Module 1 guide and recommended exercises](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/pages/1-vector-geometry), including the [reading and exercise PDF](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/files/10687612).
